notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Soldevi Adnate triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
